ppf.name: Paint Protection Film
ppf.benefit: A clear shield that takes the hit instead of your paint
ppf.problem: Road gravel, sand, keys, and half-centimetre accidents all mark the original paint — and every scratch takes money off your resale price.
ppf.solutionIntro: Japanese TAKAI film sits over the paint and absorbs the damage instead:

solutions.b1: Self-healing material — light scratches disappear with heat
solutions.b2: Full clarity, zero change to the original colour
solutions.b3: Protection against sun yellowing and chemical rain
solutions.b4: Removes cleanly whenever you choose, paint untouched

warranty.label: Warranty
warranty.value: Standard tiers: up to 15 years · Premium Plus: lifetime*

selfHealing.label: Self-healing
selfHealing.value: 15 μm self-healing coating on every tier

1.q: Will the film show on the car?
1.a: No. TAKAI film is fully transparent and follows the paint's own surface. What shows is the gloss.

2.a: One to three days depending on coverage. Full body takes its time — done properly.

3.q: Can I wash the car normally?
3.a: A week after installation, wash as usual. Steam and foam are both fine.

4.a: Thickness, warranty years, and self-healing level. Each tier has its warranty in writing, under its own name.

5.a: Self-healing handles surface scratches. Deep cuts are fixed by replacing that panel's film only.

6.q: What if I sell the car?
6.a: The warranty transfers with the car to the new owner for its remaining term — it follows the car, not the owner.

1.q: How is it different from wax?
1.a: Wax sits for weeks. Ceramic bonds with the paint itself and stays for months and years.

3.a: Hand wash or steam — and stay away from harsh brushes.

4.a: One to two days depending on paint condition — the prep and polish before coating matter most.

building-heat-isolation.seoDescription: Japanese TAKAI TK-7099-IR heat isolation film for buildings and facades in Egypt and the UAE: 99% IR rejection at 70% light. Send measurements for a quote.
building-heat-isolation.problem: Sun pours through the glass all day. The AC fights it and loses, the bill climbs, screens catch the glare, and furniture and floors fade a little more every month. The usual fixes — closed curtains or dark glass — cost you the light and the view.
building-heat-isolation.solutionIntro: One film, applied to the glass, that solves it without changing how the building looks:

solutions.b1: Rejects 99% of infrared — the main heat carrier — so the AC works less and the bill drops
solutions.b2: Blocks 99.5% of the UV that fades furniture, curtains and flooring
solutions.b3: Cuts screen glare while keeping 70% visible light transmission
solutions.b4: Holds shattered glass together so fragments don't scatter — safer for everyone inside

building-heat-isolation.positioning: Darker films score higher total heat rejection — we fit those on cars. For buildings we chose the TK-7099-IR for its balance: strong heat rejection at 70% visible light transmission. If you want a cooler space that keeps most of its daylight, this is it.

whoWeAre.title: Our story
whoWeAre.body: We started in 2016 out of a genuine love of cars and a conviction that this market deserved a different level of protection. We became the exclusive distributor of genuine Japanese TAKAI film in Egypt and the UAE, and built workshops around it to the factory's own standard: measurement before any work, documented installation at every step. The journey hasn't stopped since — partnerships with Škoda, Kasrawy and Mansour, branches from Maadi to the Fifth Settlement and from Alexandria to Dubai, past 25,000 cars protected. These are the milestones:

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: To be the Middle East's reference in protection solutions — the first name that comes to mind when you think of protecting your investment.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: Deliver genuine Japanese TAKAI film with the highest standard of installation, and keep the experience transparent: clear pricing, written warranty, visible results.

values.title: Values

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.sub: What gets asked most — answered straight

whatIsPpf.a: A transparent TPU layer installed over the paint that takes scratches and gravel instead — and removes without a trace.

whyJapanese.a: Colour stability, adhesive quality, and self-healing. TAKAI is made in Japan to strict factory standards — and we are its exclusive distributor here.

howLongInstall.a: By service: isolation half a day to a day, film one to three days, ceramic one to two days.

bookingDeposit.a: We confirm those details in the booking confirmation call — it varies by service and branch.

whichBranch.a: The nearest — every branch runs the same standards and the same material. See the branches page.

warrantyTiers.q: Why isn't there one warranty number?
warrantyTiers.a: Because warranty follows the protection tier. Each tier has its term and conditions in writing, under its own name — cleaner than a vague blanket promise.

warrantyVoid.a: Outside work on the film, accidents, or clear misuse. Details are in your tier's booklet.

warrantyTransfer.q: Does warranty transfer if I sell?
warrantyTransfer.a: Yes — the warranty follows the car, not the owner, and passes to the buyer for its remaining term.

washAfter.q: When can I wash after installation?
washAfter.a: Wait a week, then wash normally — hand or steam beats automatic brushes.

selfHealing.a: Sun heat or warm water makes surface scratches in the film disappear on their own.

bhiMeasure.q: How do I measure if I'm not a professional?
bhiMeasure.a: Measure each window or glass wall (width × height, in metres), or estimate the total area in square metres. It doesn't need to be exact — the technician re-checks every measurement on site before installation.

bhiVisit.q: Do you need to visit before I get a price?
bhiVisit.a: No. We quote on the measurements you send; the actual check happens on installation day.

bhiDuration.a: A typical apartment or office is done in a day. Large facades can take longer — the expected duration is stated in your quote.

bhiMismatch.q: What if the on-site measurements differ from what I sent?
bhiMismatch.a: The final price is adjusted to the actual measurement before any work starts — no surprises after installation.

genuine.q: How do I know my protection film is genuine?
genuine.a: Genuine TAKAI film in Egypt and the UAE comes from one authorized distributor: SupaKoto. Buy from an authorized branch, ask for the certificate of origin and import documentation (available on request), and have the warranty registered in the tier's name at installation.

authentic.metaDescription: SupaKoto is the sole authorized distributor of TAKAI films in Egypt and the UAE. Verify your film is genuine: authorized branch, documents on request, tier warranty.

hero.title: Genuine film starts at the source
hero.sub: SupaKoto is the sole authorized distributor of TAKAI films in Egypt and the UAE. Buy from the authorized source and the question does not arise.

why.title: A category problem, not a brand problem
why.body: Counterfeit protection film exists in this market. The reason is not any one brand — it is the nature of the category:
why.b1: Long supply chains that pass through several hands before a workshop
why.b2: Resellers with no chain of custody to show where the film came from
why.b3: A product the customer cannot inspect once it is on the car
why.b4: A name printed on the roll is not evidence on its own

takai.title: R&D and manufacturing in Japan — one chain of custody
takai.body: TAKAI does its research, development and manufacturing in Japan (Nippon Takai Trading & Innovation Co., Ltd., Tokyo). One country, one factory, one chain of custody from the factory to a SupaKoto branch.
takai.b3: Shipped from TAKAI directly to SupaKoto — no intermediaries in Egypt or the UAE

verify.title: Four steps you can check yourself
verify.sub: Not reassurance — specific steps, each with something to show for it.

s1.title: Buy from an authorized SupaKoto branch
s1.body: The authorized branches in Egypt and the UAE are listed on the branches page. No location outside that list sells or installs genuine TAKAI film.

s2.title: Ask for the certificate of origin and import documentation
s2.body: We hold both for our TAKAI shipments, and they are available on request. Ask the branch before or after installation.

s3.title: Have the warranty registered in the tier's name at installation
s3.body: The branch registers your car and protection tier, and you receive a warranty booklet naming the tier and its term. Keep it with the invoice.

s4.title: Know the limit of what we can verify
s4.body: We speak only for film installed at our branches. We cannot verify film sold or installed anywhere else.

1.q: How do I know my protection film is genuine?
1.a: Genuine TAKAI film in Egypt and the UAE comes from one authorized distributor: SupaKoto. To verify: buy from an authorized SupaKoto branch, ask for the certificate of origin and import documentation (available on request), and make sure the branch registers your warranty in the protection tier's name at installation.

2.q: Who is the authorized TAKAI distributor in Egypt and the UAE?
2.a: SupaKoto is the sole authorized distributor of TAKAI films in Egypt and the UAE. Genuine TAKAI film cannot be sourced from anyone else in these two markets.

3.q: Do you hand over the certificate of origin with every installation?
3.a: Not automatically. The certificate of origin and import documentation for our TAKAI shipments are held by SupaKoto and are available on request at any branch.

4.a: In Japan. TAKAI does its research, development and manufacturing in Japan (Nippon Takai Trading & Innovation Co., Ltd., Tokyo) and ships directly to SupaKoto.

5.q: I bought TAKAI film somewhere else — can you verify it?
5.a: No. We speak only for film installed at our authorized branches, and we cannot verify film sold or installed anywhere else.

6.q: How do I know my warranty is registered?
6.a: At installation the branch registers your car and protection tier, and you receive a warranty booklet naming the tier and its term. If you did not receive one, ask the same branch for it.
